cases.name: test_actual_two_rank_gloo_launch_traces_and_tensor_metrics
cases.reason: Actual two-rank CPU gloo qualification requires installed PyTorch

mpi_library: Open MPI v5.0.7, package: Debian OpenMPI, ident: 5.0.7, repo rev: v5.0.7, Feb 14, 2025

added_lines: # Inherited MPI/torch runtimes may hold locks across fork.
post_timing_changes.change: _rank returns the environment rank before querying inherited MPI/PyTorch state in a raw-fork child. The healthy nonfork benchmark adds only a false one-time constructor branch; no metrics/decorator loop or writer semantics changed. Timings remain measurements of the recorded preceding source, not remeasurements of this guard.
post_timing_changes.inverse_patch_verification: Removing exactly the recorded three added lines reproduces the measured source SHA-256.

scope: Two actual local CPU MPI ranks through automatic local launch; invalid-scalar and coordinator-disabled-writer faults injected deliberately. No Slurm, remote/multi-node, GPU/NCCL, real filesystem outage, or absent PyTorch qualification. Functional tests ran during the separate full regression suite: test durations are not performance measurements.
source_state: Working-tree source bytes stable before and after this execution; identify implementation by source_sha256.
unblock_pytorch: Install a compatible CPU PyTorch in the qualification interpreter and rerun tests/test_instrumentation_qualification.py; gloo test is real, never simulated.
